heading: CORPORATE AMERICA HAS SUDDENLY DECIDED TO STOP BLOWING MONEY ON AI (6 MINUTE READ)
blurb: Companies are cutting AI costs by mixing models instead of relying solely on premium providers like OpenAI and Anthropic. Businesses are using cheaper open-weight models for routine tasks while reserving advanced models for complex work. Cursor found a hybrid approach reduced a browser-building experiment from $10K to $1.3K, showing how companies are optimizing AI spending with flexible model choices.
